Author: Jon Klassen
Summary: A #1  New York Times  bestseller! A  New York Times  Best Illustrated Children's Book of 2011! A picture-book delight by a rising talent tells a cumulative tale with a mischievous twist. The bear’s hat is gone, and he wants it back. Patiently and politely, he asks the animals he comes across, one by one, whether they have seen it. Each animal says no, some more elaborately than others. But just as the bear begins to despond, a deer comes by and asks a simple question that sparks the bear’s memory and renews his search with a vengeance. Told completely in dialogue, this delicious take on the classic repetitive tale plays out in sly illustrations laced with visual humor — and winks at the reader with a wry irreverence that will have kids of all ages thrilled to be in on the joke.
Customer Reviews (Text): Customers find the book delightfully funny and appreciate its simple yet engaging back and forth narrative, particularly praising the incredible plot twist at the end. Moreover, the illustrations receive positive feedback, and customers note it's a great read-to-me experience for parents that's appropriate for 2-6 year-olds. Additionally, the book offers educational value with opportunities to teach inferences, and customers describe it as an entertaining experience for both kids and adults. However, the pacing receives mixed reactions, with some appreciating how well the emotion is portrayed while others find it mean-spirited.

Summary: When the kingdom's most wanted—and most charming—bandit Flynn Rider hides in a mysterious tower, the last thing he expects to find is Rapunzel, a spirited teen with an unlikely superpower—70 feet of magical golden hair! Together, the unlikely duo sets off on a fantastic journey filled with surprising heroes, laughter and suspense. This Little Golden Book retelling of Disney Tangled will thrill young children with its beautiful full-color illustrations.
Customer Reviews (Text): Customers find this book great for children, particularly as a fun way to learn to read, and appreciate that it closely follows the movie storyline while being a perfect length for bedtime. The book features nice illustrations and is easy to read, though opinions on readability are mixed. Customers like the cute artwork and consider it good value for money.
